page.overview:
Who is Cosimo Baldacci?

Cosimo Baldacci was the famed Tilean scholar who in 1204 IC offered an innovative solution to send cryptographic messages through his invention called the cipher disc.

The cipher disc is a device used for encoding and decoding messages through the use of concentric wheels imprinted with alphabetic and numeric characters. The Tilean city-states make extensive use of cipher discs to maintain the security of their diplomatic missives; however, the use of the cyphger disc is still limited in other regions of the Old World.

Cosimo Baldacci is based on the real world [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Leon_Battista_Alberti Leon Battista Alberti], an Italian architect and author, who invented the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cipher_disk cipher disk] in 1470.
